result.question: Where did the man of God go after the old prophet lied to him?

assessments.reason: “Ate bread in his house” (v19) refers to the house of the prophet who brought him back (the old prophet), so “to his house” can reasonably mean the old prophet’s house, though it is not explicit about whose ‘his’.
